tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows marked anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit) with normal red cell indices, suggesting normocytic, normochromic anemia. Platelet count is normal but both mean platelet volume and distribution width are elevated, indicating increased platelet size and variability, possibly reflecting reactive thrombopoiesis. Further evaluation for causes of anemia (e.g., blood loss, chronic disease) is recommended.
